card.name: The word known after drugs
card.fires_on: The word "known" right after "drugs" in phrases like "drugs known to prolong the QT interval". Also fires on "to" after "known".

modes.label: Drugs known to
modes.description: "known" follows "drugs" or "other drugs" in an interaction warning, before an effect such as QT prolongation.

modes.description: Rarely, the pole fires on the end of a drug name such as citalopram in an interaction passage.
